source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Day and night occur because Earth's rotation moves each place into and out of the side facing the Sun.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: It is daytime everywhere on Earth at the same time.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Day and night are caused by Earth orbiting the Sun.

intelligence.enrichment: The side of Earth facing the Sun has daytime, while the side turned away from the Sun is dark and has night. As Earth rotates, a location changes from facing the Sun to being turned away from the Sun, creating the day-night cycle. The learner correctly applies this rule: The side of Earth facing the Sun has daytime, while the side turned away from the Sun is dark and has night. Day and night are just where the Sun is visible or hidden, without needing Earth's rotation.
